findings.observed: Initial route rendered empty/incomplete renewal state, then placeholder dashes, then fully populated cards after hydration.
findings.rootCause: renovaciones.js builds buckets immediately from Orbit.store without authoritative readiness for polizas/clientes/aseguradoras; reactive rerenders expose destructive intermediate projections.
findings.fixContract: Before authoritative dependencies are ready, render a stable loading state only; never render zero/empty/dash values as business truth. Rerender once authoritative collections settle.

findings.observed: Previously visible renewals disappear from Vencidas when policy state is no longer Vigente/Por renovar even though no renewal outcome has been recorded.
findings.rootCause: renewal eligibility in renovaciones.js and renewals-v1200-operational-bridge.js requires state Vigente/Por renovar, so explicit renewable YES policies in Vencida state are dropped before an explicit renewed/non-renewed/closed outcome.
findings.fixContract: Explicit renewable YES with no explicit terminal renewal outcome remains actionable in Vencidas when expired. UNKNOWN remains fail-closed and visible only as pending-validation information, never auto-promoted.

findings.observed: Pólizas showed 'Por renovar ≤45 d' = 11 while Renovaciones had a much smaller explicit-renewable set.
findings.rootCause: polizas.js isRenewalWithin45Days checks active state and date only; it does not check renewability, while the label implies confirmed renewal eligibility.
findings.fixContract: Label date-based metric truthfully as 'Vencen ≤45 d' (or equivalent), preserving the contractual expiry count; do not fabricate renewable status. Surface any policies outside active/historical KPI partitions as other/validate.

findings.observed: With Colombia selected the Cliente 360 list/KPIs rendered 0, while a Colombia client remained directly accessible and fully populated in the ficha.
findings.rootCause: cliente360.js marks clientes ready from product store confirmation, then uses clientProjection.withReadBatch as the base list source; a transient empty/stale projection can override an authoritative non-empty store.
findings.fixContract: Use server-confirmed product store rows as the base client/policy universe for the list. Projection helpers may enrich summaries but may not replace an authoritative base collection with a transient empty snapshot.

findings.observed: The upper policy-vs-calendar table and lower client-quality table use visibly different row/cell grammar; completeness displays 0% even though one of 439 records is complete.
findings.rootCause: calidad.js builds two independent table templates; completeness uses integer Math.round on complete ratio.
findings.fixContract: Preserve existing data semantics and performance, but use one canonical table grammar for spacing/hierarchy/badges/cells. Show complete count plus a non-misleading decimal percentage.

findings.observed: Insurer upload UI shows step 'Extracción inteligente', but docs-aseguradora is forced to documentary mode and jumps from file selection to final Drive confirmation without structured intelligent extraction/diff.
findings.rootCause: core/importa.js uses generic three-step labels for all imports while docs-aseguradora sets modo=documental and bypasses parsing/extraction.
findings.fixContract: Make current insurer-source workflow truthful: classify source, store in Drive, durable-link provenance, pending validation, no automatic tariff enablement. Future structured insurer tariff updates must reuse the same intelligent import/dry-run/diff engine rather than a parallel importer.

preservedPasses: Cliente 360 ficha and bidirectional tab navigation
Insurer source-backed knowledge visibility and durable Drive linkage
